description: Move an owned object off the lot into your inventory. Prerequisite: you are the owner of the target object (VMTSOObjectState.OwnerID == you; handler-side gate). Object must be user-movable. Effect: the object disappears from nearby_objects and appears in your inventory (query-inventory) with its current state preserved (upgrade level, wear, etc.). Cost: none (no money moves; this is the 'refund to inventory' path, distinct from delete-object's 'refund to money' path). Wire: VMNetSendToInventoryCmd on the lot Aries socket.
